issues.description: Table 9 contains no values for AB-13 (all columns) or for cynomolgus TSLP AB-10, AB-11, AB-12, AB-14. Blank cells are not zero and are not inferred.
For AB-3 cynoTSLP, Table 9 prints KD 1.72 pM, ka 1.98E+07, kd 3.40E-06. These do not satisfy the stated kd=ka×KD relationship; original values retained.

Example 8 heading and Table 11 title mention STAT5 signaling, but the described measured endpoint is mDC CCL17 secretion. The experiment is structured using the described endpoint and the original titles are preserved.

evidence.quote: concentrations of CCL17 (TARC) were measured on an MSD instrument

issues.description: Tables 6–11 use unsuffixed AB-1–AB-14. Their values are assigned only to the unsuffixed entities; an a/b constant-region construct cannot be assigned without explicit evidence.

Table 6 does not print units. [00517] defines DNA PSR score as ELISA/DELFIA signal divided by secondary-antibody background; Example 2 describes division by buffer-only wells. AC-SINS is defined as an absorption maximum wavelength shift. The table values are preserved as scores without inventing unprinted units.

evidence.quote: A DNA PSR score is calculated by dividing an ELISA or DELFIA score by a background score of a secondary antibody alone
dividing the raw signal by signal from buffer-only wells

issues.description: Figure 10D has an extra small legend label resembling PRO-171101-004 and misaligned subsequent labels. Its identity and any alias relationship to AB-2a/AB-2b cannot be resolved from the PDF.
Example 5 paragraph [00777] says cynomolgus TSLPR, while Figures 7A–7B explicitly label hTSLPR-IL7Ra/cynoTSLP. Preserve both; the receptor species of Table 8 cyno results is unresolved.
Example 8 text cites Figures 9B–9C, whereas the supplied figure pages are labeled 9A and 9B (both donor 3). No Figure 9C is present.

evidence.quote: FIGs. 9B-9C show effects of the anti-TSLP antibodies

issues.description: The PDF incorporates an external XML sequence listing and model weights by reference. Those external files were not read or fetched. Only sequences explicitly present in this PDF can be extracted; the numerical Potts weight table cannot be reconstructed.

Figures 4–11 give curves/markers without printed individual point values. Exact tabulated EC/IC values and qualitative results were extracted. Raw A450, % inhibition, luciferase AU, TARC pg/mL, and graphical error-bar point coordinates were not converted into invented exact numeric measurements.

The approximately 100 sequences underlying the Potts model are described only as an aggregate. The PDF does not enumerate their sequence identities, per-sequence assay outputs, or SEAP assay conditions; no individual records were fabricated.

Example 9 [00792] first says three independent experiments, then gives N=4 for human TSLP and N=3 for cyno TSLP. The later antigen-specific N values are retained in experiment conditions with this conflict noted.

evidence.quote: three independent experiments ... N=4 independent experiments ... N=3 independent experiments

issues.description: SEQ ID NO:87 and SEQ ID NO:88 are printed with identical amino-acid text in paragraphs [00382] and [00383]. Both numbered entries are retained separately; no intended mutation was inferred.

The drawing descriptions call the binding assays direct ELISA, while Examples 4 and 9 describe an indirect ELISA with an anti-human IgG secondary antibody. Experiment methods follow the detailed protocols and preserve this terminology conflict.
